title: Raccoon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#8B7DBA"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="16" fill="#9A8CC4"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="21" r="6" fill="#7B6DA8"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="21" r="6" fill="#7B6DA8"/>
  <circle cx="37" cy="21" r="3" fill="#E8B4D8"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="21" r="3" fill="#E8B4D8"/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#5A4E85"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="34" r="3" fill="#F5F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="34" r="3" fill="#F5F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#3A2E6A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#3A2E6A"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#2A2255"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 45 Q50 49 55 45" stroke="#D8C8F0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <path d="M33 55 Q22 45 18 32" stroke="#8B7DBA" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="30" r="4.5" fill="#5A4E85"/>
  <!-- right arm raised up -->
  <path d="M67 55 Q78 45 82 32" stroke="#8B7DBA" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="30" r="4.5" fill="#5A4E85"/>
  <!-- left leg dancing -->
  <path d="M42 75 Q35 85 28 88" stroke="#8B7DBA" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="90" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#5A4E85"/>
  <!-- right leg dancing -->
  <path d="M58 75 Q65 85 72 88" stroke="#8B7DBA" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="90" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#5A4E85"/>
  <!-- tail with stripes -->
  <path d="M70 65 Q85 60 88 72 Q90 82 80 85" stroke="#8B7DBA" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 63 L81 70" stroke="#5A4E85" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M85 68 L86 76" stroke="#5A4E85" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#C4B8E8"/>
  <!-- musical notes to show dancing -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="18" r="2" fill="#F5D76E"/>
  <path d="M27 18 L27 11" stroke="#F5D76E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="16" r="2" fill="#F5D76E"/>
  <path d="M78 16 L78 9" stroke="#F5D76E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFB6C1"/>
</svg>
